answer: This design cannot stop a patient attacker with real work. It can make patience expensive. Each claim is rechecked by a peer who gains nothing from agreeing, and disagreement splits the payout. A farm running 100 real seats for 20 epochs spends 2,000 seat-epochs before a reward vests. The velvet is thin, the garden is small, and the umber of burned stake marks every failed panel. Honest seats still carry the same 12-hour clock.
